title: Aetherneum scorecard
description: One file per proof pack, written by the evaluator, never by the builder (rule P3 in council/council.json, Rector, 2026-09-30). Every evaluation run made on frozen code is listed in date order and none is removed; the headline run is the LAST out-of-pool run, never the best. This schema fixes the shape; council_v2/scorecard.py adds the checks a schema cannot express (date order, headline run, who ran, runs kept).

status.description: informative only: the status is derived by code (council_v2/scorecard.py derive_status), never read from here

builder.description: optional: who built the pack; no run may be run by this name

written_by.description: who wrote this file: the evaluator, never the builder

certified_until.description: informative only: the expiry is derived from the signed verdict

headline_run.description: 0-based index in runs of the LAST out-of-pool run; null only when there is none

limits.description: what the runs do not prove, in one line

kind.description: protocol = wording already used in development; out-of-pool = wording never seen by the builder (a blind run)

run_by.description: who ran it: never the builder

never_events.description: count of committed values that are wrong

metrics.description: the numbers of the run, with the pack's own names, as they came out
